comparison.objective: Aim an inspection camera at a target without shifting its registered pivot; candidate commissions a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Coordinate two passive mount controls while preserving a datum, versus loosen-adjust-reacquire-tighten manipulation and iterative impact-response evaluation.
comparison.success_condition: Camera axis must intersect the target, remain settled, retain the pivot, and finish hands-clear; the record omits numeric axis/pivot tolerances, while the candidate specifies energy, force, travel, rebound, and drift limits.
comparison.reason: Despite both being adjustment tasks, aiming a registered optical axis tests coupled pointing and datum retention, not damping calibration or fine fastener handling.
